about_the_game:
Support the project! Add Dr. Kinderwood’s Asylum to your Steam wishlist so you don't miss the release and news.

An epidemic of flower disease destroys a prosperous village, and the only survivor is the son of a tailor and a witch doctor. His days are numbered: the first symptoms of the incurable disease have manifested themselves, and all the doors of the kingdom are closing in front of the boy. All but one.

The unsociable owner of the fading estate, who hides his face under a sinister mask, gives the emaciated traveler refuge among other unusual guests. A circus acrobat, two thugs from the high road and a noble knight and his arrogant young master share a common misfortune: they are living out their last days here, hoping for a miraculous rescue. And the owner of the estate turns out to be a skillful healer, whose methods are not approved by either the church or the medical community.

The hero becomes a pawn in Dr. Kinderwood's chess game with death. A pawn that can turn into any piece.

Features

  • Point-and-click movement between locations and interaction with items.

  • Light up active areas for interaction.

  • Accept the consequences of the result of your active actions with a mini-game.

  • Character relationship development system. Characters can help you or refuse.

  • Several passage options to reach the goal.

  • The plot is constantly moving forward.

✦ Berest — a former bandit, sullen and suspicious.

✦ Lina — an acrobat and thief who hides her fears behind jokes and tricks.

✦ Patrick — a hot-headed young aristocrat with a secret behind his mask of arrogance.

✦ Remora — the doctor's kind assistant, simple and sweet, but not without her secrets.

✦ Doran — a knight who lives for duty and protecting the young viscount.

✦ Lopukh — a strongman with the heart of a child, rough on the outside, soft on the inside.

The infirmary holds more questions than answers. Each inhabitant represents a destiny, and each decision is a step along the fine line between hope and despair.

Will you be able to uncover the doctor's secrets, overcome illness, and influence the fates of the inhabitants?

content_descriptors.notes: Human or animal organs, blood, violent mutilation.

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 16.04+
  • Processor: 2.0 Ghz 64-bit Intel-compatible
  • Memory: 2.0 GB RAM
  • Additional Notes: OpenGL 3.0

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: 10.10+
  • Processor: 2.0 Ghz 64-bit Intel-compatible (Apple silicon supported through Rosetta 2)
  • Memory: 2.0 GB RAM
  • Additional Notes: OpenGL 3.0

name: Dr. Kinderwood's Asylum

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 or higher
  • Processor: 2.0 Ghz 64-bit Intel-compatible
  • Memory: 2.0 GB RAM
  • Additional Notes: OpenGL 3.0 or DirectX 11
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system

short_description: Decide the fate of the son of a tailor and a witch doctor infected with an incurable disease in an interactive story with multiple endings depending on your actions.
supported_languages: English, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Portuguese - Brazil, Simplified Chinese, Korean, Russian, Turkish, Japanese
